name: Ollama
short: Ollama Cloud hosts open models behind an OpenAI-compatible API, with a free plan that includes starter usage credits; local inference stays free and unlimited.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Starter usage credits and starter models; 1 concurrent request; usage resets monthly; add credits to unlock all models.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $60 of usage credits per month, 3 concurrent requests and access to larger pro models.

plans.name: Max
plans.notes: $300 of usage credits per month, 10 concurrent requests and early access to the newest models.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: Unlimited users, $1,000 of shared usage credits per month and priority support.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Volume pricing, model access controls, cost budgets and a private support channel.
